nom: Ebanel 10-Pack Collagen Face Mask with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report an initial tingling or stinging that fades within seconds, after which most describe the mask as soothing and non-irritating even for reactive skin; one reviewer without a stated sensitivity had the opposite experience, developing burning and visible redness that led her to remove the mask entirely.
segments.dry: Reviewers in dry climates or with dry, rough skin report strong hydration and a dewy, replenished result, though one reviewer found it didn't fully help her more severe winter flaking and dry patches, suggesting it suits normal-to-slightly-dry skin better than very dry, flaky skin.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature reports the mask works very well for her, contributing to a visible glow.

concerns.aging: One reviewer with mature skin reports the mask works well for her and contributes to a visible glow, and another says it makes her look younger; feedback specific to aging is limited to a couple of mentions.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several in dry climates or with dry skin, report strong hydration and a dewy, soft result; one reviewer found the mask didn't have enough liquid and felt dry, and another says it didn't fully help her more severe winter flaking and dry patches.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report mixed results: one calmed a family member's breakouts and red areas, but two others developed new redness — one describing burning and visible redness severe enough to remove the mask immediately, and another noting general redness with unremarkable results overall.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers, including some who react to many products, report an initial tingling or stinging that resolves within seconds and no lasting irritation; one reviewer's existing dry patch felt more irritated afterward, and one reviewer developed a burning reaction and removed the mask.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers report the mask does not clog pores or cause breakouts the way some other masks have, with one specifically contrasting it favorably and another noting it calmed a family member's breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Mask often doesn't adhere well or fit face shape
Generous serum, enough left over to save or use elsewhere
Occasional quality control issues like an empty pouch
Can dry out if left on past the recommended time

extraits.texte: I was really excited to try these, the first time I did it it was really cold when applying the mask, after about 10 seconds on my face it started burning. I kept it on for about 5 more minutes to see if it would go away, but it didn’t. I peeled a piece on my forehead away to see and it was super red so I took the whole thing off. I might try it again idk. Wasn’t a big fan..

I found these masks to be sufficent in providing some moisture to my face, just enough that I didn't need to apply moisturizer afterward. They don't have as much product on the sheets as other masks I've tried, but it still felt nice. I did find the mask to be something of a pain to adjust on my face. The opening for the mouth was huge and hung down below my chin! The eye openings were surprisingly narrow, so there was this slight annoyance with feeling my eyelashes catch on it overtime I blinked. I will say that it did not help with the really dry and flaky patches on my skin. I actually had one crop up on my cheek right before I tried these masks, so it was perfect timing. When I applied the mask, it stung a little a first (I have really sensitive skin apparently) but it only lasted for a couple of seconds and then it was fine. Afterward, the majority of my skin was fine but that dry patched seemed a little irritated so I did have to moisturize that particular area. So I think this mask would be great for normal to slightly dry skin, but if you're having that winter dry skin where it's really flaky and sensitive, this mask may not provide enough moisture. I think when it gets more toward summer, this masks will be perfect for when my skin is less dry. These are definitely worth checking out.

extraits.titre: Amazing for my dry sensitive skin! They’ve got a return customer
extraits.texte: I just bought these for a second time because they are great. I wasn’t expecting such great quality and results for the low price. My skin feels so soft for the entire day after using. It is very moisturizing and leaves skin smooth. I have very sensitive, dry skin, and it hasn’t caused me any issues. Each mask comes with plenty serum that I use on my neck. I don’t usually write reviews, but this deserved it

extraits.titre: Excellent for hydrating and calming irritating skin
extraits.texte: This is amazing if you have sensitive or irritated skin. I live in MN and the winters are very drying and my skin can become tight and irritated with the cold and wind. I also have very sensitive skin and was hesitant to try it because I tend to react to several products. The ingredients all looked soothing and nourishing, so I gave it a try and am so glad I did. At first my skin tingled and I almost removed the mask to wash it off, but then the tingling stopped and I stuck it out for the 20 minutes. When I took the mask off, my skin was hydrated, soothed and glowing. I recently traveled to Arizona and put 3 in my suitcase, since I figured my face would be dehydrated from the airplane and the dry heat in AZ. I was traveling with my sister and purposely brought one for her to try. She couldn't believe how amazing her skin felt and how it calmed some of her breakouts/red areas. (She already ordered her own from Amazon while we were waiting at the airport for our return flight home). I've already repurchase this product and will continue to use. I love it!!

extraits.titre: Excellent Sheet Mask "Bang for the Buck"
extraits.texte: I am on my 2nd pack of these masks and I want another pack. I love how my skin looks and feels after I use them; and I can especially see the glow the next morning. I have mature skin, and these work very well for my skin. Just be delicate when unfolding them, so you do not tear them. A little patience is needed, but it is worth it!
It is an okay product. I don’t think the quality is very good. You pretty much get what you paid for. Does provide some glow but not very effective. Had some redness to the face when using this item.

These masks are just wonderful! The thick hydrogel hugs your face snugly, holds more liquid and stays moister far longer than the paper type sheet masks, enabling the serum/essence to absorb deeply into your skin. Just for clarification, I believe the 5 pack masks are hydrogel, while the 10 pack are paper sheet masks. Hydrogel is a thick gummy or jelly like material, which I had never tried before, but now that I have, I really feel it is far superior to the paper or fiber sheet masks. Aside from the hydrogel, a couple of the other features I especially appreciate about these masks are; 1. They are super moist, packed with serum. A little too much, which is great, because before removing from the pouch, I open a corner of the package, and using a funnel, squeeze out some of the excess into a clean serum bottle for later use. I've been getting about 1/4 ounce of excess serum from each mask, enough to continue treating my face with, every day for a week. While leaving more than enough in the mask itself, to stay nice and moist for a good 30 minutes or more. 2. Other masks have clogged my pore and made me break out, or left my face with a "sticky" feeling. But after using these, my face feels smooth, soft and well hydrated, creating a great base for applying makeup. The improvement in my skin is definitely noticeable! 3.
